ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10

about.description:
pyiron was initially developed in the Computational Materials Design department of Joerg Neugebauer at the
Max Planck Insitut für Eisenforschung (Max Planck Insitute for iron research) as a framework for ab initio
thermodynamics. In collaboration with the Interdisciplinary Centre for Advanced Materials Simulation (ICAMS)
the framework was recently extended for high throughput applications resulting in the opensource release of
pyiron.
about.summary: pyiron - an integrated development environment (IDE) for computational materials science.

name: pyiron-data
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyiron-data
  version: "0.0.31"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/pyiron/pyiron-resources/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a514ee2a6ad96d88df07a13fddd68d74e5a241dc6fc0c490e71495f961346aae

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: generic

requirements:
  build:
  run:
    - sphinxdft-data >=0.0.1
    - iprpy-data >=2022.11.02

tests:
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/atomicrex/bin/run_atomicrex_1.0.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/cp2k/bin/run_cp2k_8.2.0.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/damask/bin/run_damask_3.0.0.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/damask/bin/run_damask_3.0.0_mpi.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/interactive/bin/run_sxextoptinteractive_0.0.1.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/lammps/bin/run_lammps_2024.02.07.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/lammps/bin/run_lammps_2024.02.07_mpi.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/lammps/bin/run_lammps_2018.03.16.bat
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/mlip/bin/run_lammpsmlip_2020.12.24.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/mlip/bin/run_lammpsmlip_2020.12.24_mpi.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/mlip/bin/run_mlip_1.0.0.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/mlip/bin/run_mlip_1.0.0_mpi.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/mlip/bin/run_mlipjob_1.0.0.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/mlip/bin/run_mlipjob_1.0.0_mpi.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/mlip/bin/run_mlipselect_1.0.0.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/pacemaker/bin/run_pacemaker_tf.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/pacemaker/bin/run_pacemaker_tf_cpu.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/quantumespresso/bin/run_quantumespresso_6.3.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/quantumespresso/bin/run_quantumespresso_6.3_mpi.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/randspg/bin/run_randspg_0.1.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/randspg/bin/run_randspg_0.1.bat
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/runner/bin/run_runner_1.2.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/runner/bin/run_runner_1.2_mpi.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/sphinx/potentials/potentials_sphinx.csv
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/sphinx/potentials/potentials_sphinx_jth_default.csv
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/sphinx/bin/run_sphinx_3.1.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/sphinx/bin/run_sphinx_3.1_mpi.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/thermodynamics/bin/run_sxharmpottst_0.1.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/thermodynamics/bin/run_sxdynmat_0.1.sh
      - if: unix
        then: test -f ${PREFIX}/share/pyiron/thermodynamics/bin/run_sxuniqdispl_0.1.sh

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: pyiron - an integrated development environment (IDE) for computational materials science.
  description: |
    pyiron was initially developed in the Computational Materials Design department of Joerg Neugebauer at the
    Max Planck Insitut für Eisenforschung (Max Planck Insitute for iron research) as a framework for ab initio
    thermodynamics. In collaboration with the Interdisciplinary Centre for Advanced Materials Simulation (ICAMS)
    the framework was recently extended for high throughput applications resulting in the opensource release of
    pyiron.
  homepage: https://pyiron.org
  repository: https://github.com/pyiron
  documentation: https://pyiron.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - srmnitc
    - pyiron-runner
    - jan-janssen
    - pmrv
    - niklassiemer
